bandwidth.ceiling_rule: the highest of the three measured figures; the feature kernels read ~95% of their traffic, so a copy (half writes) understates what they can reach
bandwidth.counting: copies: read + write bytes (2 x buffer); read kernel: bytes read (1 x buffer)

timing.kernel: CUDA events around the launch(es) of one full pass, no transfers
